results.rationale: Consistency: the blue-and-cream carton, cap and MILK lettering persist, but the cow drawing is redesigned and its four lower lines disappear; the splash boundary also changes beyond projection. Instruction: a viewpoint change is visible, but it remains a two-face three-quarter view with a prominent MILK face and exposed cap top, rather than the reference’s straight-on cow-side view with symmetric gable and mostly hidden cap. Quality: the edited carton has coherent planar geometry, clean legible lettering and graphics, and consistent shading without noticeable artifacts.

Consistency: red body, yellow trim, silver bumper and roof cannon remain recognizable, but an extra rear axle is added, the cab gains a rear window and changes shape, and the forward white equipment shutter becomes a solid red compartment. Instruction: the edit exposes more of a side, but faces right and retains a visible front face and oblique roof perspective; the reference is a left-facing strict profile with two axles and two white shutters. These are substantial orientation and structural mismatches. Quality: judged alone, the vehicle is coherently rendered with round wheels, connected body panels, plausible metallic surfaces and grounded shadows, without clear generation artifacts.
